seoTitle: Transcript & Subtitle Cleaner (SRT, VTT, Timestamps, Fillers)
metaDescription: Turn SRT, WebVTT or timestamped transcripts into clean paragraphs by removing cue numbers, timestamps, tags, speaker labels and filler words.
intro: Convert subtitle files and raw transcripts into readable text for articles, summaries or notes.
why:
The cleaner removes the WEBVTT header and NOTE blocks, cue numbers, time ranges and leading timestamps, HTML-style tags, optional speaker labels, bracketed sound cues and filler words (um, uh, er, hmm), then joins broken lines into paragraphs and fixes spacing and capitalisation. A setting groups sentences into paragraphs of a chosen length.

It only edits text: no speech recognition happens, and removing "um" can occasionally leave a sentence slightly unnatural, so give it a read.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Paste the subtitle or transcript text.
